excerpt: The third album from this ensemble demonstrates a thoroughly bedded in group at a point of mutual understanding ensures a unity of vision which hasn't coalesced into blithe familiarity. Music retains an edge outside the post-bop mainstream.

artist: Mark Lockheart, Huw V. Williams & Jay Davis
excerpt: A program of group-generated compositions falls well within the parameters of reeds, bass and drums trios of the post-bop persuasion. Uses overdubs which diminishes the feeling that the group's playing more or less exclusively for itself.

Wilson has appeared on nigh on 200 recordings. Given we're well past the hard-bop saturation point it takes something special to engage my ear and command the attention. Special qualities: love and an abiding commitment to the cause.
Vinyl reissue of Buster Williams' debut album as leader, originally released on Muse in 1975. The concept draws from the electrified atmosphere of Miles Davis's In A Silent Way and Bitches Brew.

Guitarist Phil Sargent maintains dual prominence in academic circles and the US jazz scene, serving as a respected music educator at New England institutions. This solo project demonstrates his commitment to the jazz tradition.

Bitches Blues, unlike its relatively exploratory, more diffident predecessor, presents a bolder set of statements, indicating that this unit has now begun to coalesce. The album showcases light and shade — avoiding clichéd thrash guitar clichés.

Contrary to the album's self-deprecating title this is attention-grabbing music and joyously executed. Vocalist Brigitte Beraha is described as the group's undoubted secret weapon — her lithe and airy voice combined with Figes' artfully constructed songs drives the album.

Kruk himself motors the tunes along with cracking snare-drum precision. Second album from this Milwaukee-born drummer, following debut Leaving Saturn (2009). Characterized by jazz-rock sensibility with Mahavishnu Orchestra influences.

Described as reminiscent of Joni Mitchell's more jazz-influenced years rather than having a Nordic influence. A powerful expression of contemporary jazz with poetic lyrics, strong melodies, sophisticated changes, and jazzy arrangements featuring international-caliber players.

This is gentle, relaxing music, carefully crafted and played with a deceptive ease. Described as folksy with hypnotic, lyrical beauty — full of repeated motifs. Originally trained on saxophone but this album is dominated by a variety of plucked string instruments.

The best music needs no explanation, and this is music with a real sense of passion and drama. Derives more from a classical than a jazz tradition with romantic nostalgia, though noted as improvised with skill and excitement.

Albanian-born singer Elina Duni's sixth ECM recording, third collaboration with British guitarist Rob Luft — now as duo format. Draws on wide variety of languages and genres including traditional pieces, Persian lullaby, Italian ballad, and Ornette Coleman's Lonely Woman.

album: At The Jazz Showcase, Live In Chicago
excerpt: Previously unreleased 1976 recording from the Jazz Showcase in Chicago. Musical characteristics: Tatum-level technique, Cole-derived swing, Garner-esque flourishes, and his own wonderful touch and ingenious use of space.

Stockholm-based composer and bassist. Album highlights Henriksson's growing assurance as a composer and bandleader. What catches the attention most is the coherent and contrasting musical ideas that develop and evolve naturally.

Ninth album from Winnipeg Jazz Orchestra. Concept album depicting lived experiences of LGBTQ+ individuals navigating identity, trauma, and healing. Composed by Sean Irvine; led by spoken word narrator Quinn Greene and singer Karly Epp.

Berlin-based jazz duo (Dhanya Langer and Max Scholl) maintain a tranquil soundscape, capturing live studio energy and natural imperfections while retaining polished production. Fuses contemporary jazz, soul, hip-hop, and electronic music.

Recorded February 1956 at RCA Studios in Chicago, this was the first release on El Saturn Records — the artist-run label founded by Sun Ra and Alton Abraham. One of the most active artist-owned record labels in the US.
